# timeless_metrics_dashboard v0.4.6 - Table of Contents

Phoenix LiveDashboard page and telemetry reporter for TimelessMetrics.

## Pages

- [README](https://timeless-metrics-dashboard.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [TimelessMetricsDashboard](https://timeless-metrics-dashboard.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetricsDashboard.md): Telemetry reporter and LiveDashboard page for TimelessMetrics.
- [TimelessMetricsDashboard.DefaultMetrics](https://timeless-metrics-dashboard.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetricsDashboard.DefaultMetrics.md): Pre-built `Telemetry.Metrics` definitions for common BEAM/Phoenix/Ecto/Timeless events.
- [TimelessMetricsDashboard.DownloadPlug](https://timeless-metrics-dashboard.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetricsDashboard.DownloadPlug.md): Plug that serves Timeless backup downloads as tar.gz archives.
- [TimelessMetricsDashboard.Page](https://timeless-metrics-dashboard.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetricsDashboard.Page.md): LiveDashboard page plugin for TimelessMetrics.
- [TimelessMetricsDashboard.Reporter](https://timeless-metrics-dashboard.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetricsDashboard.Reporter.md): Telemetry reporter that writes `Telemetry.Metrics` events into a Timeless store.
- [TimelessMetricsDashboard.Router](https://timeless-metrics-dashboard.hexdocs.pm/TimelessMetricsDashboard.Router.md): Router macro for one-line LiveDashboard setup with TimelessMetrics pages.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix timeless_metrics_dashboard.install](https://timeless-metrics-dashboard.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.TimelessMetricsDashboard.Install.md): Installs TimelessMetricsDashboard into your application.
